encryption_details.algorithm: RC4 (custom KSA and PRGA; 64-byte embedded buffer decrypted in place)
encryption_details.key_storage: Hard-coded plaintext 16-byte global g_rc4_key in .rdata at RVA 0x5000 (VA 0x140005000); the 64-byte ciphertext g_encrypted_pe is stored in .data at RVA 0x4000 and copied to the stack before decryption.

decoded_strings.encrypted_string_recovery: No encrypted configuration strings were identified; RC4 is applied to a 64-byte binary buffer treated as a PE image, while the behavioral strings are stored in plaintext.

anti_analysis: Checks loaded modules with GetModuleHandleA for sbiedll.dll to detect Sandboxie; if present, sleeps 30,000 ms and exits before payload execution.
Probes whether dbghelp.dll is loaded and resolves SymSetOptions; the result is discarded and does not affect execution, so this is not an effective debugger check.
Uses sleep delays: 30 seconds on the Sandboxie-detected path and 2 seconds after the injection attempt.
No PEB/BeingDebugged, IsDebuggerPresent, CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent, or ptrace-style anti-debugging was found.

injection_details.method: Manual PE mapping into a remote process followed by CreateRemoteThread at remote_base + AddressOfEntryPoint.
injection_details.target_process: explorer.exe; if no matching PID is found, the code falls back to GetCurrentProcessId and operates on itself.
injection_details.target_discovery: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS) with Process32First/Process32Next; compares PROCESSENTRY32.szExeFile to "explorer.exe" using case-sensitive strcmp.
injection_details.process_open: OpenProcess with access mask 0x43A (PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD | PROCESS_VM_OPERATION | PROCESS_VM_READ | PROCESS_VM_WRITE | PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION).
injection_details.remote_allocation: Reads SizeOfImage from the decrypted PE and calls VirtualAllocEx at an arbitrary base with MEM_RESERVE|MEM_COMMIT (0x3000) and PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE (0x40).
injection_details.payload_written: Resolves NtWriteVirtualMemory and NtClose dynamically from ntdll.dll. Writes SizeOfHeaders bytes to the remote base, then iterates IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER records and writes each section's SizeOfRawData bytes from PointerToRawData to remote_base + VirtualAddress.
injection_details.relocations: If the allocated base differs from the preferred ImageBase, iterates base-relocation blocks and handles IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64 (type 10) entries. It reads each remote 64-bit value with ReadProcessMemory, adds the image delta, and writes it back with NtWriteVirtualMemory. The mapper does not visibly rebuild the import table.
injection_details.thread_start: CreateRemoteThread(process, NULL, 0, remote_base + AddressOfEntryPoint, remote_base, 0, NULL), then WaitForSingleObject for 10,000 ms.
injection_details.embedded_payload: Only 64 encrypted bytes are embedded and passed as the payload buffer; the code treats the decrypted result as a PE image.
